conclusion: On this synthetic handbook, top-3 retrieval cut reading from about 75440 tokens to about 1357 with keyword BM25 or 1353 with synonym TF-IDF; asking the same 30 facts two ways, keyword BM25 found 29/30 same-word but only 4/30 paraphrased questions, while the hand-tailored synonym TF-IDF found 29/30 and 15/30 (9/15 on paraphrases its synonym map was written for, 6/15 on paraphrases written after the map was frozen).
setup: seed=404; synthetic handbook 100 pages, 50870 words; 30 planted facts, each asked with same words and paraphrased (60 questions); paraphrase sets tuning=15, later=15; sentence-aligned chunks of ~300 words (167); BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75; synonym TF-IDF = frozen hand-written synonym map + char trigrams (weight 0.2), TF-IDF cosine, not an embedding model; tokens = chars/4
